title: Rav Chiyya of Hormiz Ardashid
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 52a: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said, “Rav Chiyya of Hormiz Ardashid told me that Rav Acha bar Yaakov told him.” Rabbeinu Gershom explains that it is a royal city of Ardashid.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading and body spell the place ארדשיד, Ardashid. The William Davidson digital Bava Batra 52a text has ארדשיר, Ardashir, and fully writes Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak and Rav Chiyya, supporting those abbreviations. The source’s dalet form is retained alongside the named resh witness form; no history of the letter confusion is asserted.

The checked Bava Batra 52a paragraph and Rabbeinu Gershom’s complete comment spell Ardashir with resh; Hyman’s heading and body spell Ardashid with dalet. The source’s form is retained. The transmission chain and the royal-city gloss do not supply a history of the letter difference or a new geographical identity judgment.
